objective: Complete the missing Phase 4.4 game/schedule request submission UI using the approved DB schema and existing admin review flow.
acceptance_criteria: Add a user-facing request submission modal/component at the appropriate existing UI location supporting game requests and schedule add/edit requests per approved SRS/SPEC/SCHEMA; use schema field names/values only (game_requests.name, schedule_requests.schedule_type, etc.); derive user_id from authenticated user; client must not set admin/status fields.
Validate user inputs (including schedule date order and required values) and surface failures; preserve RLS as authority; do not bypass atomic admin RPC behavior.
Add focused regression tests for submissions/validation and any required navigation integration.
Run project tests, lint, and static build with dummy Supabase URL/key values only; no live Supabase, production credentials/data, Tauri, or Gemini.
Commit the implementation in the run worktree; Web/PWA-first, Tauri deferred.
